about: INT4 checkpoints per model and Orin runtime, chosen from the Hub's quantized derivatives (read from their configs and files): the best community build per runtime, our own only where none exists. 'role': primary is the configuration's build; alternate was considered only if the primary failed its sanity check; own marks a build we make ourselves. Vision towers stay 16-bit in every choice: GGUF entries take the F16/BF16 mmproj, not Q8_0. Tags are stable ids: runs record them. 'knob' marks a checkpoint for one of the deployment sweep's settings (W8A16, the Q8_0 mmproj), not an INT4 configuration.

qwen3-vl-8b.cyankiwi-awq4.format: compressed-tensors W4A16, group 32, symmetric; vision tower 16-bit
qwen3-vl-8b.cyankiwi-awq4.why: most used W4A16 build (569K downloads); no official INT4 safetensors

qwen3-vl-8b.sherlock-w4a16.format: compressed-tensors W4A16, group 128, symmetric; vision tower 16-bit

qwen3-vl-8b.cyankiwi-awq8.format: compressed-tensors W8A16, group 32, symmetric (MSE observer); vision tower and lm_head 16-bit
qwen3-vl-8b.cyankiwi-awq8.why: the W8A16 setting of the deployment sweep; the same quantizer and group size as the W4A16 pivot

qwen3.5-9b.redhat-w4a16.format: compressed-tensors W4A16, group 128, symmetric; vision tower 16-bit
qwen3.5-9b.redhat-w4a16.why: Red Hat AI; 163K downloads. Was the primary until the A100 sanity runs: bcq -8.5 against BF16, 81.5% agreement, and a changed answer style

qwen3.5-9b.cyankiwi-awq4.why: closer to BF16 than RedHat's on the A100: bcq -3.0, 85.0% agreement, BF16's explain-first answer style kept

qwen3.5-9b.cyankiwi-awq8.format: compressed-tensors W8A16, group 32, symmetric; vision tower and linear-attention projections 16-bit
qwen3.5-9b.cyankiwi-awq8.why: the W8A16 setting of the deployment sweep; the same quantizer and group size as the W4A16 pivot

qwen3.5-9b.quanttrio-awq.format: AWQ W4, group 128; attention, linear attention and layer 0 left 16-bit

qwen3.8-27b.redhat-int4.format: compressed-tensors W4A16, group 128, symmetric; vision tower 16-bit

qwen3.8-27b.cyankiwi-awq4.format: compressed-tensors W4A16, group 32, asymmetric; linear-attention layers 16-bit

cosmos3-nano.nathanth-w4a16.format: compressed-tensors W4A16, group 128, symmetric (llm-compressor recipe included); vision tower 16-bit
cosmos3-nano.nathanth-w4a16.why: the only INT4 build for vLLM (same Cosmos3ForConditionalGeneration architecture); little used (67 downloads), so the sanity check decides

layout.why: saved under transformers' names in one flat file; vLLM 0.30's Cosmos3 class maps only NVIDIA's own names and loads only [tv]*er/*.safetensors (tested 2026-09-29)

glm-4.6v-flash.cyankiwi-awq4.format: compressed-tensors W4A16, group 32, symmetric; vision tower 16-bit

glm-4.6v-flash.cyankiwi-awq8.format: compressed-tensors W8A16, group 32, symmetric; vision tower and lm_head 16-bit
glm-4.6v-flash.cyankiwi-awq8.why: the W8A16 setting of the deployment sweep; the same quantizer and group size as the W4A16 pivot

glm-4.6v-flash.usefulquants-w4a16.format: compressed-tensors W4A16, group 128, symmetric; vision tower BF16
glm-4.6v-flash.usefulquants-w4a16.why: does not load in vLLM 0.30: its ignore list leaves the vision attention's q, k and v unquantized one by one, which vLLM fuses into one qkv layer ('QKVParallelLinear' object has no attribute 'data')

nemotron-3-nano-omni.drawais-w4a16.format: compressed-tensors W4A16, group 64, symmetric; Mamba mixers, routers, vision and audio 16-bit
nemotron-3-nano-omni.drawais-w4a16.why: most used W4A16 build (395 downloads); NVIDIA's own are FP8 and NVFP4, which the Orin cannot run

nemotron-3-nano-omni.feanors-awq.format: compressed-tensors W4A16, group 64, symmetric; shared experts 16-bit

nemotron-3-nano-omni.mattbucci-awq.format: AWQ W4, group 64; attention, Mamba projections, vision and audio 16-bit

lfm2.5-vl-3b.sahilchachra-awq.format: compressed-tensors W4A16, group 128, symmetric (llm-compressor recipe included); vision tower, projector and conv projections 16-bit
lfm2.5-vl-3b.sahilchachra-awq.why: the only W4A16 build (154 downloads); the official INT4 is GGUF only

qwen3-vl-8b.qwen-gguf-q8mmproj.why: the vision-tower precision setting of the deployment sweep: the official GGUF with Qwen's own Q8_0 mmproj

qwen3.5-9b.unsloth-gguf.why: most used (1.3M downloads); no official GGUF

qwen3.8-27b.unsloth-gguf.why: most used (6.4M downloads); 16.5 GB, fits the Orin

cosmos3-nano.hobforge-gguf.why: the only GGUF; the reasoner re-keyed to Qwen3-VL (125 downloads)

glm-4.6v-flash.unsloth-gguf.why: F16 mmproj (ggml-org's is Q8_0); llama.cpp takes GLM-4.6V as images only

molmo2-8b.mu2-gguf.why: the only GGUF (508 downloads); llama.cpp cannot load its mmproj (unknown projector type: molmo2)

nemotron-3-nano-omni.ggml-gguf.why: llama.cpp's own org; 22.4 GB, tight on the 32 GB Orin

cosmos3-edge.ubr-modelopt-int4.format: ModelOpt INT4 AWQ with ONNX exports and Jetson Orin notes; vision, projector and embeddings 16-bit
cosmos3-edge.ubr-modelopt-int4.why: a TensorRT Edge-LLM build, not loadable by vLLM; for the Edge-LLM runtime on the Orin

molmo2-8b.own-w4a16.format: compressed-tensors W4A16, group 32, symmetric, RTN (data-free); vision backbone, embeddings, lm_head 16-bit (stored FP32, as the source)
molmo2-8b.own-w4a16.why: no INT4 safetensors build exists (FP8/NVFP4/MLX only)

north-micro.own-w4a16.format: compressed-tensors W4A16, group 32, symmetric, RTN (data-free); vision tower, embeddings 16-bit
north-micro.own-w4a16.why: no INT4 build for any Orin runtime (MLX and PARO only)

lfm2.5-vl-3b.own-w8a16.format: compressed-tensors W8A16, group 32, symmetric, RTN (data-free); vision tower, projector, conv projections, embeddings, lm_head 16-bit
lfm2.5-vl-3b.own-w8a16.why: the W8A16 setting of the deployment sweep, made only if the model is among the tiers' three; no community 8-bit build

north-micro.own-w8a16.format: compressed-tensors W8A16, group 32, symmetric, RTN (data-free); vision tower, embeddings 16-bit
north-micro.own-w8a16.why: the W8A16 setting of the deployment sweep, made only if the model is among the tiers' three; no community 8-bit build

molmo2-8b.own-w8a16.format: compressed-tensors W8A16, group 32, symmetric, RTN (data-free); vision backbone, embeddings, lm_head 16-bit (stored FP32, as the source)
molmo2-8b.own-w8a16.why: the W8A16 setting of the deployment sweep, made only if the model is among the tiers' three; no community 8-bit build

cosmos3-edge.own-w4a16.format: compressed-tensors W4A16, group 32, symmetric, RTN (data-free); transformer/ quantized, vision_encoder/ 16-bit, NVIDIA's own layout
cosmos3-edge.own-w4a16.why: the only INT4 build is an Edge-LLM export

qwen3-vl-8b.own-edgellm-awq4.format: ModelOpt INT4 AWQ (tensorrt-edgellm-quantize 0.11.0 defaults: 128 calibration samples, lm_head 16-bit); vision tower FP16
qwen3-vl-8b.own-edgellm-awq4.why: NVIDIA's benchmark configuration; NVIDIA publishes no INT4 AWQ checkpoint (runner/scripts/quantize_edgellm.sh, made on the Orin)

cosmos3-edge.own-edgellm-awq4.format: ModelOpt INT4 AWQ (tensorrt-edgellm-quantize 0.11.0 defaults, on transformers 5.17: 5.14.1 cannot load cosmos3_edge); vision encoder FP16
cosmos3-edge.own-edgellm-awq4.why: the Hub's only Edge-LLM build (ubr) is a v0.10.1 export calibrated on 198 indoor robot frames, and does not run on v0.11

qwen3.5-9b.own-edgellm-awq4.format: ModelOpt INT4 AWQ (tensorrt-edgellm-quantize 0.11.0 defaults); vision tower 16-bit
qwen3.5-9b.own-edgellm-awq4.why: NOT MADE: Qwen3.5-9B uses community quants, and none loads in Edge-LLM; it does not quantize on 32 GB either
